_comment: Calculation options of dialogs 170/2027/2030/2080 that change the Key Info pane, the longitudes table and the monthly panchanga (tests/calcVariants.test.ts skips while the output is absent). One run per variant, each into golden/jhora-calc-variants/<variant>/ with capture.py --ini overrides: vyatipata1 (VyatipataMethod=1); weekday-lmt (WeekdayDefinition=1); mahakala-lst (WeekdayDefinitionKaala=2); kaala16 (KaalaInDayNightSeparate=0); lunar0 (LunarYrDef=0); lunar1 (LunarYrDef=1); lunar3 (LunarYrDef=3); lunar4 (LunarYrDef=4); lunar5 (LunarYrDef=5); sunrise1 (SunriseDefinition=1); sunrise2 (SunriseDefinition=2). Restore the copy's jhcore/jhora.ini (golden/jhora-defaults.ini) afterwards - JHora saves its options on exit.
